column1: # THE PUBLISHED PACKAGING. A topology extracted from an upstream repo is only
# useful if the tree TENSORHUB SERVES is that topology, and the two are not the
# same thing: the hub repacks shard counts and sometimes the element type. These
# rows are the checkpoints prod actually binds, pinned by DIGEST so a later
# release cut cannot move them, and spec/v2/baselines/stamps.json asserts what
# each one stamps. They are proof, not a second reference — no CORPUS.tsv row

THE HOLE, in the packaging that exposes it: the real 9-channel inpainting UNet re-typed to bf16, which is what tensorhub publishes. v1 ADMITS this into the SDXL lane.

THE TREE sd15 BINDS (@prod): unet + vae + text_encoder + safety_checker, bf16 with two I64 position-id islands. The `.fp16.` in the member names is upstream's packaging label; the bytes are BF16, measured.
the whole published SD-Turbo tree (@prod): unet + vae + the 372-tensor OpenCLIP text encoder.

the composed tree anima BINDS (@composed-v3): the net.* dit beside the Qwen3-0.6B text encoder and the qwen-image VAE. tensorhub publishes THREE bf16 packagings of this one topology (dit/, transformer/ 2-shard, split_files/) — content-grouping makes one record admit all three.
the whole published ERNIE-Image tree (@prod): transformer + text_encoder + pe (the vision tower) and the rest of what the fleet actually binds.
the whole published upsampler tree (@prod): latent_upsampler + its vae — the vae the sub-tree extraction missed.

the plain serving tree (@serve-narrowed): bf16 transformer + narrowed bf16 text encoder + F32 vae and audio_vae. 66 GB of bf16 transformer beside 11 GB of F32 autoencoders that OUTNUMBER it by key count — the tree that forced dominance to be measured in BYTES.

the tree wan-2.2 BINDS (@prod): bf16 transformer + transformer_2 + text_encoder beside the F32 VAE upstream never converts. The F32 VAE island is why the sub-tree-era record refused the fleet's own checkpoint.
the packaging sdxl SERVES (@prod-fp16vae): the whole F16 tree with the F32 fp16-fix VAE — the mixed-dtype packaging no @1-era record covered.
the WHOLE inpainting tree — no hub packaging exists (no sdxl-inpainting family repo, measured), so the complete upstream tree is the reference

THE HOLE at whole-tree scale: the real 9-channel inpainting tree re-typed to the bf16 packaging tensorhub would publish. It must stamp sdxl-inpainting.diffusers@2 and NEVER sdxl.diffusers@2 — one conv_in shape apart.

the tree flux.1-schnell binds: FLUX.1-dev's exact shapes MINUS the four guidance-embedder tensors — schnell is guidance-distilled, so it is a DIFFERENT topology, not a variant. v1's pattern-matching hid this; a finite key map cannot.
the tree flux.2-klein-9b binds: 883 tensors across 21 members, and NOT the 4B's 818-key layout — the two Kleins are two topologies in v2, where v1's rank-only patterns served both.

wan-2.2's @serve-fp8 packaging: both denoisers cozy.fp8-rowwise (400 F8 weights + 400 F32 row scales each), text encoder bf16, VAE F32. The proof that the pair wan22.diffusers@2+cozy.fp8-rowwise@2 is real.

the H3 fp8-rowwise storage packaging: 312 block Linears quantized (transformer AND token-refiner blocks), every adaln_proj kept bf16 — the ie#681 invoke-widened skip that cozy.fp8-rowwise@2 transcribes.

anima's w8a8 fp8-rowwise packaging: 508 quantized dit Linears INCLUDING its adaln_modulation projections — the counterexample that proves the H3 adaln skip had to be spelled `adaln_proj`, not `adaln`.

SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MoT-Preview, the whole published tree at the repo root: 13 shards named `-of-00016` (00002/00003/00004 exist neither in the repo nor in the weight_map), 1116 tensors. The MoT split is keys, not files, and the generation stream is stored F32 for layers 0-38 while the understanding stream is BF16 throughout.
